description_en: Returns the details of SQL throttling rules
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-sql-rate-limiting-rules --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000 --rule-name-list testrule --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAARbaCuN6hiD08qrLdwJ9Fh3QbdIPYBaCDXsvvjLHCQfi --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSQLRateLimitingRules

parameters.help_en:
The name of the SQL throttling rule that you want to query. You can specify multiple rule names for a batch query. Separate the rule names with commas (,).

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html operation to query the details of all SQL throttling rules for the cluster, including the rule names
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的SQL限流规则名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量查询，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html接口查看目标集群下所有防火墙规则的详情，包括规则名称
parameters.name: rule_name_list

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值为100。

默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page of results
parameters.name: next_token
